text:
anya: Pushed the region-slicer quant bench results for mosaic-like model. Warmup sensitivity looks weird in APAC on h100.
raj: link?
anya: https://console.redwood.internal/bench/region-slicer/2234567890 :chart_with_upwards_trend: - I attached raw CSVs.
claire: quick summary? numbers are small to scan on phone.
anya: TL;DR — h100 US/EU median latency 28ms @ 2048 tokens, APAC median 44ms. a100 more stable ~35ms across regions. Throughput drop in APAC only when warmup < 60s.
tom: did you use quant-8 or q4/fp16? which kernel?
anya: ran both q8_0 and q4f16. Kernel choice: cuBLAS for fp16, triton-xla fallback for q4 in APAC due to kernel availability. Suspect kernel mismatch.
raj: can you paste the warmup sequence command? and scheduler config used?
anya: sure

```
./bench_run --model mosaic-13b --quant q4f16 --region apac --gpu h100 --warmup 30 --duration 300 --scheduler continuous_batcher --max_batch_tokens 4096
```

anya: summary CSV head:
```
region,gpu,quant,warmup,median_lat_ms,p95_lat_ms,throughput_tok_s
us,h100,q4f16,30,28,62,1200
eu,h100,q4f16,30,29,64,1180
apac,h100,q4f16,30,44,102,820
us,a100,q4f16,30,35,70,950
apac,a100,q4f16,30,36,73,930
```
claire: APAC p95 spike looks like cold kernels. How long until stable if you extend warmup?
anya: tried warmup 120s — APAC h100 median drops to 30ms, p95 68ms, throughput up to 1160. So warmup-dependent.
bench-bot: note — GPU driver versions differ: apac-h100: 525.60, us-h100: 530.12
tom: that driver delta could explain kernel selection fallback. Also check cuDNN/cuBLAS patchlevel.
raj: can we reproduce by forcing kernel selection? i.e., force cuBLAS path on APAC h100 for q4 run (if possible) and compare.
anya: attempting a forced kernel run now, will post logs. If we can keep warmup to 60s and force cuBLAS, we should isolate scheduler warmup vs kernel.
infra-bot: scheduled compute job job-223456799 on apac-h100 cluster (queue: region-slicer). ETA ~ 6m.
claire: also add a run with max_batch_tokens=2048, sometimes larger max batch increases latency tail when kernel mis-optimized.
anya: good call — will run that too.

raj: if this is kernel-induced, solution path:
- vendor patch (drivers/cuBLAS)
- bake kernel build into our AMI for APAC
- fallback policy: route q4->a100 in APAC for stable latency until kernel fixed

anya: putting provisional action item: "temp route q4 requests to a100 in apac for mosaic-13b until kernel patch confirmed". Can ops evaluate cost impact?
claire: ops:cc @tom
tom: will simulate cost delta. initial guess +12% for burst to a100.
anya: results from forced-cublas run (short): apac h100 forced cuBLAS q4f16 warmup 60s => median 31ms, p95 70ms. Looks much closer to us/eu.
raj: confirms kernel selection issue. Good find.
anya: creating a tiny bug/inc ticket and linking bench artifacts.

```
/bug-2234 region: APAC h100 q4 kernel fallback => latency tail
attachments: s3://bench/region-slicer/2234567890/*
```

claire: nice work. next steps: (1) patch drivers in APAC image, (2) short-term routing rule, (3) add warmup guidance in docs (recommend >=60s for h100 q4), (4) re-run full sweep after fixes.
anya: will draft the doc blurb and the ticket. thanks all :thumbsup:
thread_summary: Region-slicer quant bench found APAC h100 latency tail due to kernel fallback; forced cuBLAS run improves numbers; next steps: driver patch, routing, warmup guidance.
